svg.title: YIMA Taahhut ve Insaat
svg.desc: Postcard for YIMA Taahhut ve Insaat (corporate website, TypeScript): Website for a road, railway and infrastructure contractor. Filterable project gallery with a video player. Service and corporate detail pop-ups. WhatsApp button; all content in one file. Built with React 18, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS.
